description: REST API for a todo list using Python and FastAPI
global_context: Use Python 3.12, FastAPI, and SQLite for storage. Follow standard project layout with src/ directory.

tasks.description: Create pyproject.toml with FastAPI and uvicorn dependencies, create src/app/__init__.py and src/app/main.py with a basic FastAPI app that returns {"status": "ok"} on GET /health

Create src/app/models.py with Pydantic models: TodoCreate (title: str, description: str = ''), TodoUpdate (title: str | None, description: str | None, completed: bool | None), TodoResponse (id: int, title: str, description: str, completed: bool, created_at: datetime)
tasks.verification: python -c "from app.models import TodoCreate, TodoUpdate, TodoResponse; print('OK')"

tasks.description: Create src/app/database.py with SQLite connection management using sqlite3 stdlib. Create a todos table with columns: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT DEFAULT '', completed BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP. Provide functions: init_db(), get_db() -> sqlite3.Connection
Add a POST /todos endpoint to src/app/main.py that accepts TodoCreate, inserts into the database, and returns TodoResponse with status 201
Add a GET /todos endpoint to src/app/main.py that returns a list of all TodoResponse objects
Add a PATCH /todos/{todo_id} endpoint to src/app/main.py that accepts TodoUpdate and returns the updated TodoResponse. Return 404 if not found.
Add a DELETE /todos/{todo_id} endpoint to src/app/main.py that deletes a todo and returns 204. Return 404 if not found.
